packageRules.description: The amazonlinux container tags in test.yml are the supported install targets (they must match the OS labels published by jksy/imagemagick-build), not dependencies to bump.

Tools that CI builds from source (see .github/tools/). Their dependencies stay at the versions each tool release selects, so only the tools themselves are updated. Vulnerability alerts still open fixes for the dependencies.
go.mod marks the tool `// indirect` like every other dependency, so it is enabled by name. go mod tidy moves the rest of the dependencies to the versions the new release selects.
A new Go major version is a different module path, which the workflows build by name.
